blockingFindings: scripts/codex/launch.mjs does not handle child stdin/stdout/stderr stream errors. A premature child exit or pipe failure can escape terminal handling, leaving no structured failed finish event and violating fail-closed review persistence guarantees.
missingNegativeTests: Add deterministic child-stream failure tests proving exactly one failed terminal event and zero persisted review artifacts.

architectureAssessment.deepModules: Review parsing, binding, persistence, and cancellation are separated, but the child-stream failure boundary is incomplete.
architectureAssessment.hexagonalArchitecture: The Codex CLI is isolated behind a process adapter with launcher-owned validation and no fallback or production authority.
architectureAssessment.eventedBoundaries: Progress and terminal events are centralized, but unhandled stream errors can bypass the terminal controller.

exactNextAction: Update scripts/codex/launch.mjs to route synchronous and emitted child stdin/stdout/stderr errors through one idempotent failed-terminal path, then add deterministic zero-publication regression tests.
